description: PHP class 'sysinfo' providing system information for SunOS, including kernel details, hostname, IP address, uptime, load averages, CPU info, network stats, memory, filesystems, and distribution info.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A class to retrieve system information on SunOS systems, including kernel details, hostname, IP address, uptime, load averages, CPU info, network statistics, memory, filesystems, and distribution info.

methods.name: kstat
methods.description: Executes the 'kstat' command to retrieve kernel statistics for a given key.

methods.name: vhostname
methods.description: Returns the server's hostname environment variable or 'N.A.' if not set.

methods.name: chostname
methods.description: Retrieves the canonical hostname by executing 'uname -n' and resolving it.

methods.name: ip_addr
methods.description: Returns the server's IP address, either from environment or by resolving hostname.

methods.name: kernel
methods.description: Returns the OS name and version by executing 'uname -s' and 'uname -r'.

methods.name: uptime
methods.description: Calculates system uptime based on boot time kernel statistic.

methods.name: users
methods.description: Returns the number of users logged in.

methods.name: loadavg
methods.description: Retrieves load averages for 1, 5, and 15 minutes.

methods.name: cpu_info
methods.description: Gathers CPU model, speed, cache, and number of CPUs.

methods.name: sbus
methods.description: Placeholder for SBus info, currently returns empty.

methods.name: network
methods.description: Retrieves network interface statistics using 'netstat' and kernel stats.

methods.name: memory
methods.description: Gathers memory and swap usage statistics.

methods.name: filesystems
methods.description: Retrieves filesystem mount points and types.

methods.name: distroicon
methods.description: Returns the icon filename for SunOS.
